I know Voat merchandise has been requested quite a lot in the past, most recently here, but we never really had the means to launch and manage our own merchandise store... I just tested teespring.com and created Voat May 2016 campaign to test the waters. Teespring, if there is enough interest, could be something we can consider using in the future. Teespring operates the store and handles everything for us, and we get a profit cut. If you want to buy an item from this campaign, you can use "voatgoat" promo code to get a small discount at checkout.

When I created the campaign I set the goal to 50 units and was hoping we would sell out in the next 3-4 days, but so far we've already sold 39 units in 3 or 4 hours...
